request: Audit Cloudflare container status and existing token file metadata without revealing paths or tokens.

bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
s=$(docker ps -a --format '{{.Names}}|{{.Status}}' | grep -i cloudflare || true)
if [ -z "$s" ]; then s=NONE; fi
p=/home/admin1/projects/astera_v8
f=$(sed -n 's/^CLOUDFLARE_TUNNEL_TOKEN_FILE=//p' "$p/.env" | head -n1)
case "$f" in /*) if [ -f "$f" ]; then statv=$(stat -c '%a|%u|%g|%s' "$f"); else statv=MISSING; fi;; *) statv=NONABSOLUTE;; esac
body=$(printf 'TUNNEL_SAFE_AUDIT\ncontainers=%s\nsecret_file_metadata=%s\n' "$s" "$statv")
gh api -X POST repos/G-ACE-inc/server-core/issues/10/comments -f body="$body" --jq '.html_url'

chat_decision_checkpoint.source_evidence: Vault PR9 deployed and healthy Issue10 #6226212418; assess existing consumer and Secret file metadata before Vault import.
